title: TempElytra
description:
Create your own TempElytra using Worldguard regions. You can glide with TempElytra until you land and exit the region. You can boost by switching hands (default F)
The plugin uses the regionflag "start-glide-without-elytra"
body:
# TempElytra
Minecraft Java Plugin for WorldGuard that adds a flag allowing players to start flying without an elytra! Compatible with 1.21+.

## Installation
1. Download WorldEdit, WorldGuard, and TempElytra for your preferred version.
2. Place the `.jar` files into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Start the server and enjoy!

## Requirements
- WorldGuard (requires WorldEdit)
- Minecraft version 1.21 or higher

## How to use
1. Mark a region using WorldEdit's wand (right-click one corner, left-click the opposite corner).  
2. Create a region using WorldGuard: `/rg create <region> <player>` or use an existing one.  
3. Set the flag: `/rg flag <region> start-glide-without-elytra allow`.  
4. Fall at least 1.1 blocks in the region to start gliding.  
5. Press "Switch Hotbar" to boost.

## Important notice
- Make the region slightly larger than the intended area so players cannot jump out without entering glide mode.

## Config Options
- `boost` — Boost multiplier applied when launching or boosting.  
- `max-boosts` — Maximum free boosts available (use by pressing Switch Hotbar).  
- `allow-sneak-cancel` — Allow players to cancel flying with TempElytra midair.  
- `min-fall-distance` — Define which falldistance to trigger Elytra
- More options coming...

## Reload config
- `/tempelytra reload`


## Future additions
- More configurable options
